QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: correctionSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Highest priority sends one fresh stream to vehicles, preferring the local base station, then NTRIP, then UDP. Choosing a source never falls back to another. UDP forwarding sends the same stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Vehicle correction source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpInputEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Receive RTCM corrections from another application over UDP.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Listen on a UDP port for incoming RTCM3 correction data and forward it to connected vehicles via MAVLink GPS_RTCM_DATA.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable UDP RTCM input

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpInputPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Local port that receives the corrections.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port to listen on for incoming RTCM3 correction data.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP RTCM input port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpOutputEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Forward the correction stream selected for vehicles to another application over UDP.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Forward corrections over UDP

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpOutputAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: IP address that receives the forwarded corrections.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP output address

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpOutputPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Port that receives the forwarded corrections.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP output port
